comment: The rules of the headless runner of PR-15 (D-1181, D-1184, D-1185). The runs start on the maps of the list in turn by seed: an even seed in the fixture dungeon, where Game starts, and an odd seed on the fixture hub. A run ends as complete when the goal flag is on: the party beat the rats in the straw of the fixture hub. PR-35 links the maps, and PR-17 moves the goal to the story of the first playable. PR-15 measured the tick budget: three times 783, the longest greedy run to the goal over seeds 1 to 2000.
